title: Labour mayors in England vow to cap tourist tax at 5%
description: Reform UK and the Conservatives have criticised plans for the new levy on visitors' overnight stays.

title: Oil, gas and borrowing costs surge as fears over Middle East escalate
description: The price of oil jumps to $105 a barrel amid signs the Iran war will not be resolved quickly.

title: Use all powers necessary on anti-migrant protests, home secretary tells police
description: Two anti-migrant protests took place in Dover and Portsmouth last weekend.

title: Can Trump pay $5,000 to every American adult if Republicans win midterm elections?
description: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

title: Watch: Is the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition worth the hype?
description: Crowds have been flocking to the British Museum to see the Bayeux Tapestry as it's on public display in the UK for the first time since it was created nearly 1,000 years ago.

title: Four hurt and seven arrested in London stabbing
description: Seven people are arrested after a fight that an eyewitness says broke out near a KFC restaurant.

title: Drone display recreates the Twin Towers over New York City
description: Organisers say each of the 2,977 drones in the display represents a victim of the 9/11 attacks.

title: Esther Rantzen says she is too fragile to travel to Switzerland to end life
description: The broadcaster and campaigner says she missed her chance to go before living with cancer became "unbearable".

title: Police and army attend funeral for officer killed in wrong-way A66 crash
description: Former army colleagues attend PC Tom Clough's funeral alongside police and emergency workers.
